uso: Fondo de la zona de juego (dados y estado).
prompt: Seamless tileable texture. Worn green baize card-table cloth with faint cigarette burns and pale glass-ring stains. Flat lighting so it tiles, no objects, low contrast, no vignette.

uso: Fondo de paneles de lectura: formulario de partida y mensajes de chat.
prompt: Seamless tileable texture. Yellowed bookmaker's ledger paper with faint blue ruled lines and a few coffee stains. Completely free of text, folds that break the tile and vignette; very low contrast so text on top stays readable.

uso: Marcos, bordes y fondo de las cabeceras de ventana.
prompt: Seamless tileable texture. Dark mahogany wood with scratches and old cracked varnish. Flat lighting so it tiles, low contrast, no dominant features.

uso: Adorno de esquina de las ventanas (se gira por CSS a las 4 esquinas).
prompt: A corner ornament for a frame, TOP-LEFT orientation, arms running along the top and left edges: tarnished brass Art Deco corner bracket, stepped geometric fan motif. Arms end cleanly at the canvas edges (touching the top and left edge is allowed for THIS asset), transparent elsewhere. Matches the palette and materials of the skin.

uso: Separador horizontal entre secciones.
prompt: A thin horizontal divider, perfectly symmetric left-right: an Art Deco line with small stepped ends and a tiny diamond in the exact centre. Readable on both dark and light backgrounds.

uso: Barra de título de las ventanas (se estira a lo ancho).
prompt: A window title-bar strip: dark mahogany strip with a thin tarnished-brass inlay line along the bottom edge. The middle 80 % must be plain with NO focal features so it can stretch and tile horizontally; left and right edges must tile horizontally.

prompt: A small tied canvas money bag with a bundle of banknotes peeking out of the top. Bold silhouette, readable at 32 px.

uso: Fondo de escena para jugar (opcional): el GM lo pone como imagen de la escena.
prompt: Top-down round green-baize poker table with a worn leather rail, an ashtray with a smoking cigarette, a whisky glass and a few chips near the OUTER edges only. The central 60 % of the picture is clear, calm and low-contrast so game tokens read perfectly on top. Slight dark vignette at the corners. No text, no characters.

uso: Imagen principal de la skin: ficha del módulo y selector. ¡Es la referencia de estilo!
prompt: HERO EMBLEM (still life, no characters): Two ivory dice resting on a crumpled banknote next to a lit cigarette in a glass ashtray, hard side light, a thin curl of smoke. Centered compact composition, rich painterly detail, no text, no background.

uso: Cabecera del README y de la página del módulo (solo en la skin base).
prompt: Wide cinematic establishing shot: Black-and-white-movie noir: the smoky back room of a 1930s city gambling den, one hanging bulb, bourbon rings on the table, menacing but stylish. A round gaming table in the lower foreground, shallow depth of field. The LEFT 35 % is calmer and darker (a title will be overlaid there). No people, no text.
